description:
Outcome: A developer can run and verify Plotbook, enabling brief.md: First version must
Scope: Select and document stack, relational database, hosting, job and mail adapters; application skeleton, migrations, synthetic fixtures, test/build scripts and local fake email. Excludes: Product workflows
Acceptance: Document clean setup; collect and pass smoke tests; build/check succeeds; development readiness endpoint works; real email and job prerequisites recorded; enable approved Full pipeline stages only once commands and tests are established
Behaviour: Explain missing configuration and startup failures; keep credentials out of files
Verification: During implementation, demonstrate clean setup, smoke test, build/check and readiness; never install or run these during Storybloq setup. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: Technology selection delegated by owner; record choices before dependent implementation; missing provider credentials block live delivery/release but not local development
title: Establish application and verification tooling
